_comment: Data policy and promotion gate for the monthly / drift-triggered retraining. threshold_policy and review_share must be the same as in monitoring.json (checked by a test). fixed_tree_count = tree count of the tuned model v1 (Optuna trial 21), used instead of early stopping. holdout_days = newest labelled days for the gate (the rest is fit data, no validation split); reference_days = last days of the fit window used as the drift reference. holdout_days must be the same as in monitoring.json.
